title: European Forum Alpbach scholarship programme
overview: Scholarships to take part in the annual two-week European Forum Alpbach in the Austrian Alps. The scholarship pays the participation fee and accommodation, not travel.
program_dates: European Forum Alpbach 2027: 23 August to 3 September 2027, Conference Days open 29 August 2027
deadline_text: No 2027 call yet. For the 2026 Forum: 'The European Forum Alpbach application platform will open from 2-22 March 2026.'
expected_next_cycle: The 2027 Forum dates are announced (23 August to 3 September 2027) but the scholarship application period is not. In 2026 the platform was open 2-22 March.
funding_details: A scholarship covers the participation fee for the entire Forum and accommodation
Travel to and from Alpbach, daily expenses, health care and travel insurance are paid by the participant
An 'advanced scholarship' adds a lump sum toward travel and on-site costs for applicants with the greatest need
eligibility: Up to the age of 30; up to 35 for applicants from the Global South, which by the UNCTAD definition includes Africa
Applicants from all countries and professional or academic backgrounds
age_requirement: Up to 30, or up to 35 for applicants from the Global South
application_process: Apply on the Forum's application platform during the March window
Ask for an advanced scholarship in the same application if travel costs are a barrier

sources.label: European Forum Alpbach home page (2027 dates)

eligibility_reason: Applicants from Africa are accepted up to age 35 and from any background, which the profile meets.
potential_issues: Flights to Austria, the Schengen visa, insurance and daily expenses are not covered by a regular scholarship
The advanced scholarship lump sum is awarded only to those with the greatest need
benefits: Two weeks of seminars and debates
relevance_reason: Open to any background and to Africans up to 35, but the uncovered travel cost from Kinshasa is the real obstacle.
upfront_cost_risk: High: flights, visa and insurance must be paid before travel unless an advanced scholarship is granted.
action: Look again in February 2027 and apply for the advanced scholarship if you go ahead.
notes: 9 November 2026: scholarship FAQ re-read; it still describes the 2026 call (2-22 March 2026). No 2027 call yet.

title: McKinsey.org Forward learning programme (Fall 2026)
overview: Free multi-week online programme teaching practical workplace skills: adaptability, communication, problem-solving, and digital and AI essentials. Applications are open until 5 October.
program_dates: Multi-week programme following the application window
deadline_text: Official FAQ, 9 November 2026: 'Applications are not open at the moment. However, you can still register your interest through this online form to stay informed ... when a new application cycle opens in your country.' The previous cycle closed on 2026-10-05 (earlier reading).
expected_next_cycle: Recurring programme; previous cycle closed on 2026-10-05.
funding_details: Official FAQ: 'No, Forward is free for eligible participants as part of McKinsey's social responsibility commitment. There are no fees to apply, register, or partake in any of the two levels, provided you are eligible.'
Participants use their own internet-connected device and internet access; ten weeks, about two hours a week for the Core Skills level
No stipend, travel or certificate fee is mentioned; this is a free online programme, not a funded mobility
participation_fee: None: 'There are no fees to apply, register, or partake'
eligibility: Live in a country where Forward is available; the FAQ's Africa list includes the Democratic Republic of the Congo
Working or with prior work experience (including internships or apprenticeships), or preparing to start work in the next 12 months
Less than 5 years of total work experience (exceptions stated for nonprofit, non-corporate or non-managerial roles)
At least a high school education or equivalent
Command of English, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Latin American Spanish or Arabic
experience_requirement: Reported: under 5 years of work experience; internships count
language_requirement: Primarily English; a secondary source says the digital content is also translated into French

title: French-African Foundation Young Leaders programme
overview: Annual French-African Foundation programme for young leaders from Africa and France: two weeks of meetings, training and exchanges with public and private decision-makers, one week in France and one in an African country. Applicants must be 28 to 40 with at least five years of professional experience.
program_dates: Two weeks: one in France and one in an African country (dates of the next edition not stated)
deadline_text: The Young Leaders page shows 'EDITION 2025 - Candidatures clôturées !' (applications closed). No dates for the next call.
funding_details: Not stated on the page read.
eligibility: Âge : avoir entre 28 et 40 ans (aged 28 to 40)
Langue : être bilingue en anglais ; la maîtrise du français est un atout (bilingual in English; French is an asset)

Expérience professionnelle : au moins 5 années d'expérience professionnelle avec des compétences en leadership et un impact démontrables (at least five years of professional experience with demonstrable leadership and impact)
Vision : a clear wish to build bridges between African countries and France
Nationality of a country of the African continent, or French nationality
Selection by an independent jury on excellence, commitment and potential

language_requirement: Bilingual in English; French is an asset
